latestReleaseNote.title: 1.4.1 production quality release
latestReleaseNote.summary: Promotes the accepted 1.4.1 beta review as a production quality release with Stage 3 challenge-stage gameplay keepers, beta sign-in repair, audio/theme lane clarity, public-safe foreground audio balance, refreshed security evidence, and stronger release gates while keeping score submission guarded pending server-side validation.

method: Natural developer challenge launch, stationary/no-fire, 60Hz; frames -4 through +8 relative to previously observed first contact, every two frames.
limitations: Fixed baseline target IDs and seeds; not a general release gate.
Graphics selection is captured in snapshots; no automatic pixel-overlap or original-fidelity verdict.
